title: Change your pensioner or concession details on maritime products
summary: You can update your pensioner or concession details for maritime products by visiting a Service NSW Centre.
intro:
If you need to let Transport for NSW know that your pensioner or concession details have changed, you can do so at a Service NSW Centre.

Note: It is the same process for adding pensioner or concession details for the first time or for subsequent changes and updates.
what_you_need: the PDF form – 'Change of Records – Maritime Products Only'

how_to_steps.text: Make sure you have all the required documentation.
Visit a service centre and provide the information in person.
